_comment: Example queries for scripts/harvest_openalex.py. Replace the blocks and queries with your own; {NAME} inside a query is replaced by blocks.NAME. cap = maximum records retrieved per query (by relevance). Each query is searched in titles and abstracts.

blocks.BUILDING: (building OR buildings OR construction OR "built environment")
blocks.TIMBER: ("mass timber" OR "cross-laminated timber" OR CLT OR "glued laminated timber" OR glulam)

queries.Q01_timber_embodied_carbon: {TIMBER} AND ("embodied carbon" OR "life cycle assessment" OR LCA OR "global warming potential")

Q02_digital_twin_operation.query: ("digital twin" OR BIM OR "building information modelling" OR "building information modeling") AND ("facility management" OR operation OR maintenance) AND {BUILDING}

queries.Q03_site_computer_vision: ("computer vision" OR "deep learning" OR "object detection") AND ("construction site" OR "construction progress" OR "construction safety")
